description: Studio pipeline job type (Story 35.7): run one deferred-work sweep on the execution substrate through the studio. The tk-studio-launch surface's sweep verb starts `bmad-loop sweep --no-prompt` detached in the run's worktree with a pre-minted run id and waits for the triage (bmad-loop-sweep's partition of deferred-work.md); max_bundles and the attempt caps come from .bmad-loop/policy.toml (an instance may add max_bundles to the payload). One-shot: every bundle commits on the run branch, the host leg runs once at the engine's end, and the close-out opens one PR listing the bundles, the blocked entries and the human decisions; the merge flips the entries to resolved through the plan pull-back.
